definitions.gloss: kanji numerals ({一|いち}, {二|に}, {三|さん} …)
definitions.explanation: Numbers written with kanji characters rather than Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3). Standard in vertical writing and formal documents.

examples.japanese: {漢数字|かんすうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{縦書|たてが}き→縦書き：13871_tategaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漢数字|かんすうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Kanji numerals are often used in vertical writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{改|かい}ざん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漢数字|かんすうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Amounts on invoices are sometimes written in kanji numerals to prevent tampering.

notes:
{漢数字|かんすうじ} are numbers written with kanji ({一|いち}{二|に}{三|さん}…) instead of Arabic numerals ({算用|さんよう}⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧).

USAGE:
- Vertical (⟦{縦書|たてが}き→縦書き：13871_tategaki⟧) text generally uses {漢数字|かんすうじ}; horizontal text often uses Arabic numerals.
- Formal and legal documents may use the elaborate forms {壱|いち}・{弐|に}・{参|さん} to prevent forgery.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {算用|さんよう}⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧: Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3)
